push.title: D 3-3 vs Chody Chums | You: 9.0
push.body:
buddskees, a 9.0 against Chody Chums. I'd give that a gold star if I could find my sticker book.

THE GOOD
+ 36 passes, your busiest match yet. You kept the engine turning over.
+ A brace against Chody Chums. Somebody check the net for scorch marks.
+ Man of the Match, your 4th for us. You carried the moment and carried us.
+ Top-rated Grizzly in the match. Proof you've got another gear.
+ Fewest missed tackles on the team (0). Quietly brilliant, and I noticed.

THE BAD
- Only 1 tackle attempted. Simple fix: Second-ball awareness: after a header or clearance, be the first one to the loose ball. You're closer than you think.
- No key passes from 36 passes. Here's a thought: Look for the third man: pass to the feet of the player who can find the runner. Promise it's worth it.
- Misplaced passes 9, up from your usual 3. From the clipboard: When the lane closes, switch the point of attack instead of threading the needle.
- Shot accuracy 50%, down from your usual 73%. Back to basics: Look up before you shoot. Half a second tells you where the keeper's weight is.
- 3 goals conceded: -0.1. Slow down a hair.

Before next match: Sprint back the first five yards. That's the moment counter-attacks are won or lost.

buddskees, one more thing before you log off: Fall seven times, stand up eight, then ask for the ball.

You make this job too easy. Don't tell the gaffer. - Coach Lasso

An 8.0, BellyTb1. That's a sturdy front porch of a performance. We can build a house on it.

THE GOOD
+ 28 passes (up from your usual 19). You were a constant option, and options win games.
+ Won 2 of 3 tackles (up from your usual 40%). Their attackers are gonna have nightmares about you, and I mean that kindly.
+ You and buddskees combined like peanut butter and banana. Underrated and delicious.
+ 6th straight match at 7.5 match rating. Keep stacking those bricks.

- finishing hit you and PhogsToffees both. Partner drill: square it when the keeper commits.
- Lowest passes attempted on the team: 28 (best was buddskees's 36). Mark my words: Show for it. Move into the passing lane and ask for the ball instead of hiding behind your marker.

Fundamentals drill: Side-foot for accuracy inside the box; power is for outside it.

Remember, BellyTb1: Heart wins the fifty-fifties.

The comeback starts now. - Coach Lasso

push.title: D 3-3 vs Chody Chums | You: 7.9
push.body:
PhogsToffees, a 7.9. Not flashy, just useful, and useful wins matches.

THE GOOD
+ 6 shots at Chody Chums's goal. Shoot your shot. You did, over and over.
+ 2 key passes. A good pass is a love note. You wrote a few.
+ Tackles won 4, up from your usual 1. Write that one down and stick it on the fridge.
+ Your vision plus buddskees's finishing equals a very happy coach.
+ Pass accuracy 86%, up from your usual 77%. That's a habit, and habits win leagues.

THE BAD
- 1 goal from 5 on target. Small change, big gain: We're hitting the target, so now aim for the corners. Keepers love a shot down the middle. No sweat, just reps.
- Both you and BellyTb1 dipped on finishing. Lean on each other: square it when the keeper commits.
- Assists 0, down from your usual 1. Honest truth: that cost us.
- Lowest match rating on the team: 7.9 (best was buddskees's 9.0). That's where the match slipped.
- Most missed tackles on the team: 4 (best was buddskees's 0). Bread and butter: Stay on your feet. Slide only when you're certain of the ball and there's somebody behind you.

Backyard drill: Timed finishing only when you trust it. A clean shot to the corner beats a mistimed rocket.

Hey, PhogsToffees. Hope is a plan with its shoes untied. Tie 'em.

Tomorrow's a fresh pitch. Let's go make some divots. - Coach Lasso
